queries: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Types are grouped by ordertune values present after the inner join; types with no matching risk/margin records are not counted as zero-count types in the average. A NULL ordertune, if present, would form its own group.

The average count across types is the unweighted mean of per-type counts. The 'average amount by which counts exceed that average' is the mean of (count - overall average) over the above-average types.

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Types are the distinct ordertune values among matched records; a NULL ordertune, if present, forms its own group and counts as a type.
The average across types is the unweighted mean of per-type counts, computed only over types with at least one matched record.

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Orders with a NULL ordertune are grouped as their own type (one group) rather than excluded; types with no matched risk/margin records are not counted in the average across types.
The average across types is the unweighted mean of per-type counts over types having at least one matched record.
